info.title: Runkite Internal (Runner) API
info.description: Runner-facing internal API. Authenticated via X-Runner-Kind + X-Runner-Token headers. Run-bound proxy routes require the original X-Runkite-Run-Incarnation from the dispatch, X-Runkite-Generation and exactly one public run identity header: X-Runkite-Run-Id or X-Runkite-Run-Id-B64 (canonical unpadded base64url of UTF-8). Unbound tenant-scoped routes accept X-Runkite-Tenant-Id or X-Runkite-Tenant-Id-B64; missing tenant means default. Do not send raw and encoded forms together. Bound routes derive the exact tenant from the assignment. Use matching proof-aware planes and runners. Missing or mismatched original record identity is rejected; never derive it from a newly looked-up run.

thread_id.description: Custom string identifier; new run/thread IDs must not be '.' or '..'.

on_behalf_of.description: Optional attenuation of the authenticated parent identity. Omit to inherit. Identity and claims cannot be replaced; permissions may only narrow the parent's authority. An empty list cannot remove existing restrictions. Null is rejected.

AgentSchemaReport.description: Schema publication body. The path determines agent_id; a supplied body agent_id cannot select another agent. Schema fields are optional in the existing handler. Definitions can contain sensitive annotations, defaults and examples.

IdentityProvenance.description: Bounded claims captured after strict admission JWT validation. Actor entries are assertions by that issuer, not proof of actor key possession. No bearer values or arbitrary claims.

WorkloadProvenance.description: Public facts from the verified certificate bound to this dispatch. Not accepted from client headers or JSON.

DelegationContract.description: Registered exchange intent. Does not establish that an exchange or downstream operation ran, or that the configured actor possessed a key.

RunUsageReport.description: Cumulative self-reported usage for one logical isolated execution, including across reclaim. Sequence reuse requires identical content. Counters and known cost cannot regress. A final report cannot be extended. Total tokens must fit the supported integer range. Not provider-verified billing.

get.description: Validate the original stored record, generation, frozen runner kind, pool and optional workload owner. A matching terminal record remains readable after lease removal. Authentication or binding denial must stop execution.

put.description: Replace the schema for an existing agent in the effective tenant. This retains startup publication's replacement semantics. When authenticated runner-kind context and a configured agent runner_kind are both known, they must match. No-token local mode retains its existing behavior. Publication is not code, reporter-version or readiness attestation.

post.description: Atomically fill an existing tenant-scoped schema row only when all four stored fields are exactly {"type":"object"}. Does not insert a missing row or replace useful, annotated or partial reports. An incoming all-stub report is a no-op. A 204 response does not distinguish a recovered row from an unchanged row. Requires the optional AgentSchemaRecoveryStore extension, implemented by the four built-in stores. Older planes do not support this route; clients must not fall back to replacement PUT. Known configured runner-kind checks match startup publication. This does not establish code freshness or refresh an existing MCP session catalog.

post.description: Proxy one unambiguous JSON-RPC request through connector policy. Unreleased mcp.tools_only limits inbound methods to initialize, notifications/initialized, ping, tools/list and tools/call. Other requests return a local JSON-RPC method-not-found error; denied notifications return HTTP 202 without forwarding. Denied proxy methods do no downstream credential work. Initialization advertises only the upstream tools capability without listChanged. Session issuance can independently acquire credentials. Tool arguments must be an object when present. Managed tool calls pin a configured target snapshot before policy evaluation. Approval for another target is not consumed; changed targets need a new pending action and fresh review, including when action capture is off. Only a pre-dispatch 401 connector_session_invalid permits capability renewal. Upstream 401 returns 502 connector_upstream_unauthorized and may follow execution; do not automatically replay.

post.description: Create a child of the currently assigned parent. Requires exact run/generation binding, including generation zero only for an actual zero assignment. parent_run_id must match the run header. Tenant and principal come from the active assignment and frozen parent manifest; on_behalf_of can only narrow authority. Depth and breadth limits still apply. This does not provide per-worker isolation within a trusted runner kind.
